Ashley (support): @Maya thanks for the report — we're looking into the invoice vs dashboard mismatch. You said billed tokens are ~3x the "served" tokens in the console, right?
Maya (customer): yes, invoice line 2026-02-28 shows 1,200,000 tokens billed but console shows ~400k served for that project. Customer using continuous-batcher + prefix caching.
Ashley (support): Can you paste an example request id or a recent request time window? We need an x-request-id or trace to correlate logs.
Maya (customer): request id: req_20260228_8f3a, model: open-7b-quant, region: us-west-2. Calls are mostly streaming chat with function calls.
Ashley (support): thanks. Running quick checks, opening ticket to eng-runtime. @Samir can you grab metering pipeline logs for req_20260228_8f3a and any batcher sessions around 2026-02-28 16:00-18:00 PST?
Samir (eng-sre): looking. Initial grep shows multiple batch sessions for that client id; I see warmup prefetches hitting KV cache followed by actual requests. Sample log snippet: 
```
2026-02-28T16:12:05Z session_id=ses_44 prefetch_keys=[pfx_user_123] prefetch_tokens=900 metered_tokens=900
2026-02-28T16:12:07Z session_id=ses_44 request_id=req_20260228_8f3a model=open-7b-quant served_tokens=300 cache_hit=true metered_tokens=900
```
Samir (eng-sre): The metering pipeline currently records metered_tokens at prefetch time and again at serve time for the same session_key in some code paths; that could double-count.
Kevin (eng-runtime): hmm, we did a change to continuous-batcher logic last month to prefetch likely prefixes into the KV cache to reduce tail latency. Prefetch generates synthetic "prefetch" requests which go through the same metering hook. We intended prefetch to be excluded from billing, but looks like the exclusion flag didn't propagate when sessions are long-lived and prefetch+serve happen under same session id.
Lin (billing): from billing perspective we charge based on metered events in the pipeline. If prefetch and serve both emit events with tokens, they sum. We need clear dedupe or a prefetch-only metric.
Ashley (support): @Maya sorry for the disruption. We'll either issue credits or adjust the invoice depending on the root cause. Samir/Kevin, can you confirm repro steps we can run on staging to reproduce the billed>served delta?
Samir (eng-sre): repro steps I used: spin up a client that opens a long-lived streaming session and triggers two-phase requests: 1) prefetch simulated prompt prefix size 900 tokens; 2) actual user message leading to 300 served tokens. On staging, check metering events in kafka topic `metering.events` for duplicate session_key + seq. Example query: `SELECT * FROM metering.events WHERE session_id='ses_44' ORDER BY ts;`
Samir (eng-sre): sample metering events from staging: 
```
{"ts":"2026-03-01T10:01:05Z","event":"prefetch","session_id":"ses_44","tokens":900,"billing_flag":null}
{"ts":"2026-03-01T10:01:07Z","event":"response","session_id":"ses_44","tokens":300,"billing_flag":"metered"}
```
Samir (eng-sre): billing_flag null meant it defaulted to billable. We need to ensure prefetch sets billing_flag="prefetch" or should be filtered before accumulation.
Kevin (eng-runtime): I can reproduce locally. Looks like when the prefetch runs inside the continuous-batcher worker thread, it shares context and doesn't set `is_prefetch=true` for the metering middleware. Will patch to explicitly mark prefetch events and add a de-dup key: (session_id, prefetch_key) + a TTL so metering skips duplicates within window.
Lin (billing): once you have the patch, we'll run it on a small cohort and backfill adjustments for affected invoices. Also need an alert for large billed>served deltas (threshold >20% per day) so we catch regressions earlier.
Ashley (support): @Maya sorry for the disruption. We'll either issue credits or adjust the invoice depending on the root cause. Samir/Kevin, can you confirm repro steps we can run on staging to reproduce the billed>served delta?
Samir (eng-sre): repro steps I used: spin up a client that opens a long-lived streaming session and triggers two-phase requests: 1) prefetch simulated prompt prefix size 900 tokens; 2) actual user message leading to 300 served tokens. On staging, check metering events in kafka topic `metering.events` for duplicate session_key + seq. Example query: `SELECT * FROM metering.events WHERE session_id='ses_44' ORDER BY ts;`
Samir (eng-sre): sample metering events from staging: 
```
-- find projects with billed > 1.5x served last 7 days
SELECT project_id, SUM(billed_tokens) AS billed, SUM(served_tokens) AS served
FROM billing.agg_daily
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY project_id
HAVING SUM(billed_tokens) > 1.5 * SUM(served_tokens);
```
Samir (eng-sre): that returned 6 projects including Maya's org id. I'll attach list to ENG-3421.
Ashley (support): Lin, can you provisionally credit Maya's invoice for the delta while we validate?
Lin (billing): yes will issue a provisional credit for the difference and flag for reconciliation after fix. Please include invoice id and credit reason.
Maya (customer): thank you, appreciate the fast response. Any mitigation I can do client-side?
Kevin (eng-runtime): short-term client mitigation: disable client-side prefetch or reduce prefetch token size; set `prefetch_enabled=false` in SDK config. We'll also ship server-side fix.
Ashley (support): summary/action items: 1) Kevin to open PR to mark prefetch events non-billable + dedupe logic (ETA 24-36h). 2) Samir to run detection and list affected projects (done, attached to ENG-3421). 3) Lin to issue provisional credits to affected customers including Maya. 4) Support to notify customers with recommended SDK config to disable prefetch while we roll out. 5) Postmortem and inventory of metering hooks to avoid similar false-positives.
Kevin (eng-runtime): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/4812 depends on a small schema change to metering.events to add `event_type` and `dedupe_key`. Running unit tests.

Ashley (support): I'll keep Maya updated. Thanks everyone. Escalating ENG-3421 and tagging billing for reconciliation.

Maya (customer): thanks team, will wait for confirmation.
Kevin (eng-runtime): follow-up: added a short-term hotfix to the canary that sets prefetch events to `event_type:prefetch` and ensures billing pipeline ignores them. Will run backfill filter to exclude prefetch events for last 30 days before final reconciliation.
